description.value: The South Hill Branch is part of the Vancouver Public Library system, serving the South Hill neighbourhood along the Fraser Street corridor. As a public library, it provides a welcoming indoor rest stop for touring cyclists passing through this part of Vancouver. The branch is operated by the City of Vancouver and offers a publicly accessible space with no admission required.
